purpose: High-lift rear mast with vertical guides raising hopper pivot to clear 1m bin
code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,4))
ax.set_xlim(0,1.0); ax.set_ylim(0,1.3)
ax.plot([0.1,0.8],[0.15,0.15],'k-',lw=3)
ax.plot([0.15,0.15],[0.15,0.3],'k-'); ax.plot([0.65,0.65],[0.15,0.3],'k-')
ax.text(0.3,0.05,'chassis low frame')
ax.plot([0.65,0.65],[0.3,1.05],'k-',lw=3)
ax.text(0.68,0.65,'vertical guide mast')
ax.plot([0.2,0.65],[0.45,0.45],'b-',lw=2)
ax.text(0.25,0.5,'hopper stowed 0.45m')
ax.plot([0.35,0.95],[1.05,1.05],'r-',lw=2)
ax.text(0.3,1.1,'hopper raised lip 1.05m over bin')
ax.plot([0.85,0.95],[0.0,1.0],'k--')
ax.text(0.86,0.5,'bin lip 1.0m')
ax.annotate('150mm actuator x2 4:1 chain', xy=(0.65,0.4), xytext=(0.1,0.9), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'))
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png', dpi=150)
